content: अनुपलब्धि {%f.%} Non-recognition, non-perception (प्रत्यक्षाद्यभाव); नास्ति घटोऽनुपलब्धेः (the knowledge of घटाभाव is possible because the प्रतियोगी or counter-entity is not found with the non-entity or अभाव, that is, there being no उपलब्धि or knowledge of the घट); one of the instruments of knowledge according to the Mīmāṃsakas, but not according to the Naiyāyikas.
